settings:
# Sensitivity checks (plan §5, Table 3): one setting changed at a time, all datasets, one seed,
# 5 outer folds. Descriptive only (no tests); each run is compared with the main-experiment run of
# the same method, dataset, seed and fold. 24 configurations x 32 datasets x 5 folds = 3,840 tasks.
datasets = "all"
seeds = [0]
outer_folds = 5
reference = "main"

[[check]]
name = "k_half"  # ceil(K/2)
methods = ["random_xx", "target_xx", "residual_xx"]
cascade = { k_mode = "half" }

[[check]]
name = "k_double"  # 2K
methods = ["random_xx", "target_xx", "residual_xx"]
cascade = { k_mode = "double" }

[[check]]
name = "forests_4x4"  # Zhou & Feng (2019): 4 + 4 forests per layer
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "nonlinear", "monotone"]
cascade = { n_forests = 4 }

[[check]]
name = "trees_500"  # Zhou & Feng (2019): 500 trees per forest
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "nonlinear", "monotone"]
cascade = { n_trees = 500 }

[[check]]
name = "no_binning"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "nonlinear", "monotone"]
cascade = { n_bins = 0 }

[[check]]
name = "no_binning_relu"  # without binning, all three monotone activations are tried
methods = ["monotone"]
base = "no_binning"  # compare with the base cascade without binning
cascade = { n_bins = 0, activation = "relu" }

[[check]]
name = "no_binning_gelu"
methods = ["monotone"]
base = "no_binning"
cascade = { n_bins = 0, activation = "gelu" }

[[check]]
name = "oof_5"  # 5 OOF folds instead of 3
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "nonlinear", "monotone"]
cascade = { oof_folds = 5 }
